nodes.text: Open the required profession and its expansion tier. Clear recipe filters, select Cushion of Time Travel and let Toybox read the actual learned recipe. If this character lacks the tier or required skill, follow a supported prerequisite route or choose another activity.

nodes.text: Prepare the recipe’s required materials: 25 Contoured Fowlfeather, 5 Iridescent Plume, 5 Spool of Wilderthread, 1 Chronocloth Bolt. These quantities describe one representative quality selection. Use any alternative quality the live recipe accepts; do not add every quality rank together. Reserve each material once across planned crafts. Review missing inputs before spending.

nodes.text: Bring the compatible tools listed by the live recipe: no separately listed tool. An already owned compatible substitute counts; do not buy duplicate tools just because a reference item ID differs.

recovery.text: Refresh the actual profession, recipe and inventory. Continue or Skip moves the guide cursor only; it never creates learned recipes, materials or toy ownership.

details.destinationPolicy: Inspect this exact recipe and your profession equipment. Tradable compatible tools can use the same optional AH procurement route; bound tools require their own crafting source.

nodes.text: Review the selected recipe, tools and actual reagent slots, then craft Cushion of Time Travel yourself. Crafting uses only the player’s chosen materials and never creates ownership in saved observations.

recovery.text: If the game refuses the craft, read its actual missing tier, skill, specialization, tool or reagent restriction and return to the relevant preparation step. Do not infer craftability from recipe knowledge alone.

nodes.text: Use Cushion of Time Travel from your bags yourself. Wait for the Toy Box to report ownership; crafting and item receipt are separate from learning.

recovery.text: If the item is missing, check inventory, bank and mail. If the game blocks learning, inspect its actual profession or item restriction. The guide does not mark the toy owned from a completed craft.
